params.name: srcOffset
params.description: Source position for the copy (relative to the beginning of srcBlob)

params.name: dstOffset
params.description: Destination position for the copy (relative to the beginning of dstBlob)

params.name: len
params.description: Number of bytes to be copied

overloads.semanticRole: Copies a specified number of bytes from one offset of a source BLOB to a specified offset of a destination BLOB, resizing the destination if needed.

constraints: The destination BLOB can be resized if necessary to accommodate the copied bytes.
